title: A wider opening at the same speed
hook: Change cross-sectional area and predict volume-flow rate.
misconception: volume-flow rate stays fixed when cross-sectional area doubles.
objective: Apply Q = Av to compare volume-flow rate when cross-sectional area changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With uniform fluid speed held fixed across the opening, Q = Av. When cross-sectional area doubles, volume-flow rate becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model Q = Av; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider uniform fluid speed held fixed across the opening, with a nonzero initial result. If cross-sectional area triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on volume-flow rate?
recall.why: Apply Q = Av under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
